Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

As a Sales Engineer Gauging within the Production Process & Analytics (PPA) business unit of the Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a key role in driving commercial success across our Quality Control Systems portfolio.

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships across assigned industrial markets and territory. Reporting to the Global Commercial Leader, you will execute strategic sales initiatives, identify opportunities for market expansion, and deliver value-driven solutions that help customers improve their manufacturing processes.

Your technical expertise, consultative selling approach, and ability to build lasting customer partnerships will be essential in achieving sales objectives and supporting the continued growth and profitability of the business.

A Day in the Life:

- Achieve assigned bookings, revenue and profitability targets.
- Develop and execute territory sales plans to identify and secure new business opportunities.
- Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through quotation, negotiation and closing.
- Identify AI-enabled solutions and digital services to support business growth and deliver measurable customer value.
- Maintain an accurate sales forecast and opportunity pipeline using Salesforce.com.
- Collaborate with partners and representatives to support commercial growth.
- Provide valuable market intelligence by monitoring market trends, competitive activities and customer-specific requirements.
- Develop trusted relationships with existing and prospective customers.
- Analyze customer production processes and recommend technical solutions that improve quality, productivity and operational efficiency.
- Engage customers with AI-enabled discussions and commercial solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer experience through responsiveness, technical expertise and solution-oriented support.
- Demonstrate and present the technical capabilities and business value of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Quality Control Systems.
- Collaborate closely with application specialists, service engineers, software experts and product management to develop customer-specific solutions.
- Maintain a high level of product, application, industry and AI knowledge to effectively position our solutions.
- Travel throughout the assigned territory and internationally as required, with approximately 50% overnight travel.

What to expect:

- Drive sales growth by achieving commercial targets across the assigned territory.
- Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
- Lead complex technical sales engagements from prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
- Deliver consultative, value-based sales solutions tailored to customer manufacturing processes.
- Work cross-functionally with technical experts, service teams and product management.
- Utilize Salesforce.com to manage opportunities, forecasting and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends and competitive activities to support strategic business growth.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific through regular customer visits and extensive travel.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience.

Experience

- Minimum of 3 years of successful technical sales experience in capital equipment, industrial instrumentation, process analytics or industrial automation.
- Proven experience selling complex technical solutions to manufacturing customers.
- Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
- Metal
- Packaging & Converting
- Battery Manufacturing
- Experience working with distributors or channel partners is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills with a customer-focused mindset.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
- Ability to understand complex manufacturing processes and translate them into customer-focused technical solutions.
- Understanding of AI and digital technologies as emerging commercial enablers within industrial markets.
- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) together with digital sales and collaboration tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
- Additional language skills are an advantage.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively.

Benefits:

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com)

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for an

IT-Expert Backup & Storage(d/f/m)

- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.

- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Responsibility for the stable, high-performance and highly available operation of the enterprise storage and backup environment based on NetApp ONTAP and Veeam in an on-premises environment.
- Independent planning and execution of maintenance, firmware updates, patches and technical optimizations in productive operation.
- Analysis and resolution of complex malfunctions in 1st and 2nd level support, as well as coordination with manufacturers and external support teams in case of escalation.
- Further development and optimization of existing operational processes in incident, change and problem management according to ITIL standards using tools such as BMC Remedy, Jira and Confluence.
- Development and maintenance of Ansible playbooks for the automation and standardization of operational and maintenance tasks.
- Close collaboration with IT, architecture and specialist departments to implement technical requirements, as well as active participation in the lifecycle management of the systems.
- Creation and maintenance of technical documentation, operating manuals and SOPs to ensure sustainable knowledge transfer.
- Participation in on-call duty and willingness to work shifts as part of operational activities.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Several years of experience in the operation and troubleshooting of complex storage and backup infrastructures.
- Excellent knowledge of NetApp ONTAP and Veeam Backup & Replication, ideally complemented by certifications such as NCDA, NCIE or VMCE.
- Experience with ITIL-based operational processes and tools such as BMC Remedy, Jira and Confluence.
- Good knowledge of Ansible for automating administrative business processes.
- Independent, structured and responsible work style with a high service and solution orientation.
- Strong communication skills and enjoyment of collaborating with technical and professional contacts.
- Willingness to participate in on-call duty and shift work.
- Excellent German and good English skills, both spoken and written.

jobs.description:
About the Company

CHN Energy Europe Research GmbH (CHEER) is a subsidiary of CHN Energy Investment Group (China Energy) based in Berlin, Germany. Being an integral part of China Energy’s globalized research and development layout, CHEER features in integrated European-Chinese innovation culture and advanced technology, and operates business in new energy technology research and development with purposes of promoting and accelerating carbon neutrality and making its own contribution in alleviating global climate change.

Its parent company, China Energy, operates eight business segments including coal, thermal power, new energy, hydro-power, transportation, coal-to-chemicals, environmental technology and finance. Those businesses distribute in more than 10 countries and regions, including China, Europe, the United States, Canada and Australia. It is the world’s largest producer of coal, thermal power, wind power, as well as coal-to-chemicals. It is ranked 92nd in the Fortune Global 500 in 2025.

Centered on the green development strategy and the strategy of innovation-driven scientific and technological development, CHEER is committed to building a world-class research institute with global competitiveness. We focus on six key R&D areas: diversified power conversion, advanced chemical engineering, hydrogen energy, artificial intelligence, energy storage, and new environmental protection technologies.

We are building teams to develop cutting-edge sustainable and affordable technologies to improve energy efficiency, protect the environment, and mitigate climate change. Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, skill, imagination, passion, and teamwork of people like you. Currently we have openings for leading experts with a range of focus areas including energy, chemistry, and artificial intelligence. We offer competitive compensation packages and excellent benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Develop AI algorithms and technologies to optimize predictive models and improve materials development strategies, thereby accelerating the discovery and optimization of catalysts.
2. Apply robotics-based high-throughput experimentation to rapidly synthesize and test a vast array of catalyst candidates, expediting the identification of highly efficient catalysts.
3. Use AI algorithms to analyze chemical data, predict the properties of potential catalysts, and support the design of new catalysts with improved activity and selectivity.
4. Employ AI-based computational modeling techniques to predict catalyst behavior at the atomic level, simulate reactant adsorption, activation, and reaction pathways, identify promising catalyst candidates, and guide experimental work toward the most effective design directions.

Qualification Requirements:

1. Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field (e.g., Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering).
2. Professional experience in AI algorithms or related research/industry projects.
3. Deep understanding of Transformer architectures and their variants; familiarity with large models such as BERT, GPT, and LLaMA.
4. Experience with distributed training, model parallelism, and model compression.
5. Proven experience in large model development and optimization; proficient with frameworks such as ChatGPT, DeepSpeed, Megatron; knowledge of RLHF and PEFT.
6. Strong research track record with publications in top international conferences/journals, or highly cited research outputs/patents.
7. Excellent project management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams.
8. Very good English skills are required; German and/or Chinese is an advantage.

Join us and become a leader in driving clean energy innovation, together shaping the brilliant future of the new energy sector!

We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer an attractive compensation package based on the responsibilities of the role, the candidate’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and overall fit. Additional benefits and supplementary payments may be granted in accordance with company policies and individual eligibility.
- Excellent research environment**:** Sufficient research funding and access to advanced digital tools and innovative technologies.
- Innovative workplace: Exciting and diverse tasks in an international R&D setting with a collaborative, open atmosphere.
- Room for creativity: Freedom to contribute your own ideas and actively shape forward-looking solutions in sustainable energy, technology, and organizational development.
- International collaboration: Interdisciplinary projects and partnerships with renowned academic and industry players across Europe, including opportunities for international exchange.
- Career development: Tailored training programs, individual career pathways, and support for participation in professional events and confe

Application process:

Please send your application documents by email to

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

Subject line: “[Position] – [Your Name]”.

Your application should include:

- CV (including information/listing of representative research projects for R&D positions)
- University certificates / transcripts (if available)
- Reference letters from previous employers (if available)

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your data for the purpose of the recruitment process.

All documents will be treated confidentially in accordance with GDPR. We retain applications for up to six months after completion of the recruitment process, unless you give explicit consent for longer storage.

For questions regarding the position or the application process, please contact our Recruiting Team:

recruitment@chnenergyeurope.com

Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Forschung, Entwicklung, Materialwissenschaft

Job description

In order to support, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Senior SAP ABAP Developer (f/m/d)

Airbus Defence & Space is seeking a German-based Senior SAP ABAP Developer (f/m/d) to drive our digital transformation. You will join an international, cross-functional team designing end-to-end ERP solutions. If you are dynamic, eager to learn, and passionate about the SAP portfolio, apply now!

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work in an environment that offers a broad perspective and you will drive technological innovations across multiple domains.

On campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts. Our collaboration is equally dynamic—working in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges across advanced aerospace and defense technologies. Those seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.

- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facility
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Development & Maintenance: Develop, test, and maintain ABAP code while writing technical documentation.
- Collaboration & Standards: Work closely with Key Users/Service Owners and apply Airbus development standards and SAP Best Practices.
- Optimization & Analysis: Perform root-cause analysis and drive quality, performance, and security improvements.
- Future Strategy & Change Management: Contribute to S/4HANA strategies and ensure compliance within the Change Management process.
- Mentoring: Guide, coach, and mentor junior developers within the department.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education & Experience: Degree in IT (or equivalent) and 10+ years of practical experience in ABAP programming (S/4HANA preferred).
- Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of OO-ABAP, Adobe Forms, DDIC, BAPIs, IDOCs, OData, Web Services, and Enhancement Framework.
- Functional & Extra Skills: Experience in core SAP modules (e.g., FI-CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM) and SAP certifications are a plus.
- Soft Skills & Leadership: Analytical thinking, problem-solving mindset, team spirit, and the ability/willingness to coach new colleagues.
- Languages: Strong communication skills in both German (C2) and English are a must.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

As a System Engineer you will be responsible for performing configuration, validation, deployment, and testing, of Airfield Lighting Control and Monitoring Systems (ALCMS).

You will be at the core of ADB Safegate’s customer relationships in Solutions Engineering, part of the Airfield Business Line. The role involves delivering end-to-end customer projects, from supporting pre-sales and design to configuration, cabinet set up, testing and on-site commissioning. It is a cross-functional role that requires working with teams across the globe. The System Engineer has the opportunity to take ownership, solve problems and grow our business. ADB Safegate provides new System Engineers with extensive on-the-job training allowing them to become familiar with the applicable regulations and standards and reach a great understanding of the airfield lighting industry and product lines.

Project engineering leadership

- Lead project lifecycle from production release to customer acceptance.

Testing and Validation Support

- Preparing and conducting Factory Quality Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests and customer trainings.
- Test and maintain operating systems, application software and system management tools.
- Adhere to local and international safety and quality standards during testing and commissioning.

- Possess a high level of autonomy and professionalism that enable you to accomplish goals.

- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 30% of the time.

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Industrial Automation, or equivalent. Master’s degree is a plus.
- Minimum of 3-5 years of relevant work experience. Experience in the aviation sector or with airfield lighting systems is highly desirable.
- Practical knowledge in configuring Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
- Understanding system schematics, redundancy, and system architecture design.
- Experience with Siemens PLC S7, TIA Portal or similar.
- Experience with network communication (Ethernet TCP/UDP) and fieldbus systems (Profibus, Modbus, CANbus, ProfiNET, etc).
- Experience with network configuration and hardware setup.
- Experience with AutoCAD drawings.
- Project management skills/experience -- ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, be a true team-player and effectively time-manage and prioritize under pressure.
- Ability to work cooperatively in cross-functional, multiple geographic location setting.

Competencies

- Technical/Job Knowledge
- Ownership & Decisiveness
- Accountability
- Customer orientation
- Adaptability
- Cultural awareness
- Health & Safety compliance
- Continuous Learning
- Problem Solving
- Integrity/Ethics
- Results Orientation
- Team Player

This growth presents a unique set of challenges and opportunities, particularly in addressing the looming 50% capacity shortage by 2035. As a System Engineer at ADB SAFEGATE, we offer you the opportunity to work in a dynamic team focused on deploying systems pivotal to the global aviation industry's core operations.

- A dynamic and innovative work environment with opportunities to work in the development and improvement of impactful systems in the aviation sector.
- The chance to work with a diverse and skilled team dedicated to continuous improvement and excellence.
- Professional development through leadership and technical challenges in airfield systems development.

* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. Your role
Within People Advisory Services Tax, we support organizations in managing and transforming their global mobility programs. Our integrated approach brings together hands-on operational assignment delivery with strategic mobility transformation, helping clients provide an effective employee experience while continuously evolving how mobility operates. We are looking for a (Senior) Consultant to join our Mobile Talent Operate and Mobility Transformation team. The role focuses on the end-to-end assignment lifecycle, while also supporting strategic transformation projects that shape the future of global mobility. Your wide-ranging responsibilities in our team will include:

- Act as a central point of contact for the mobility teams of multinational clients in Germany and abroad
- Coordinate services across the end-to-end assignment lifecycle, including expatriate tax, social security compliance, immigration, global compensation management and third-party relocation providers
- Prepare and review assignment-related deliverables such as cost estimates, balance sheet calculations, assignment letters and mobility documentation
- Contribute to Mobility Transformation projects, including project management activities, the development or refresh of mobility programs and assignment policies, and participation in workshops, strategic meetings and client decision-making
- Contribute to proposals, marketing materials, articles and thought leadership, and identify opportunities to provide additional services that benefit our clients

Your skillset

- A university degree in Business Administration, Management, Human Resources, or a related field, combined with a structured and organized approach to work and the ability to manage multiple projects and clients simultaneously
- A strong interest in global mobility, with enthusiasm for combining operational assignment delivery with strategic transformation initiatives, complemented by a client-focused mindset and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English, with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality, accurate work, even under tight deadlines

Your mindset

- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.
- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.
